channel.description: Latest articles from The Sun Media Corporation (thesundaily.my)

item.title: Penang deploys 1,280 police for Thaipusam security
item.description: Penang police deploy 1,280 personnel for Thaipusam, managing traffic and safety for over a million visitors with road closures and drone bans in effect.

item.title: Central Yards Edible Art Fair debuts in Hong Kong: Adding a brand new, first-of-its-kind event to the rich cultural calendar of Hong Kong this March
item.description: HONG KONG SAR - Media OutReach Newswire - 29 January 2026 - Central Yards Edible Art Fair was conceived by founder and creative director Arbiona Cadman, CEO of the renowned events and catering company Feste Group, with art curation by independent art consultancy firm Art-Partners, and proudly sponsored by Central Yards.

item.title: Shopee Illustrates How Content Creators Help Malaysians Ring in CNY with Style
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR, MALAYSIA - Media OutReach Newswire - 29 January 2026 - As Malaysians gear up for Chinese New Year, Shopee CNY Sale showcases how local content creators are helping shoppers celebrate the season with style, meeting evolving needs for trend-conscious, affordable, and easily curated festive looks.

item.title: US judge halts Trump’s refugee detention policy in Minnesota
item.description: A federal judge blocks Trump's plan to detain refugees in Minnesota, ordering their immediate release and upholding their legal rights.

item.title: EU warns of humanitarian catastrophe in Ukraine from Russian strikes
item.description: EU's Kaja Kallas warns of a humanitarian catastrophe in Ukraine as Russian strikes on power grids leave civilians in darkness and cold this winter.

item.title: Malaysia moves to cap PM’s tenure to two terms
item.description: The government is proposing a constitutional amendment to limit the Prime Minister's tenure to two terms, a move aimed at preventing power concentration and abuse.

item.title: Two terms, then you’re out
item.description: A public consultation finds nearly 90% support for a term limit on the Prime Minister, with a two-term cap being the most popular choice.

item.title: FAM executive committee resigns en masse, notifies FIFA and AFC
item.description: The Football Association of Malaysia's entire executive committee has resigned, with the governing body formally notifying FIFA and the AFC of the collective departure.

item.title: “I promise I’m not joining the bazaar,” – M’sian woman cooking fail leaves netizens in stitches
item.description: A viral photo of a pitch-black plate of mee goreng sparks hilarious reactions online, with netizens questioning the ingredients and cooking method.

item.title: TAT Unveils Lalisa ‘LISA’ Manobal as Amazing Thailand Ambassador, Inviting Travellers to ‘Feel All the Feelings’
item.description: BANGKOK, THAILAND - Media OutReach Newswire - 29 January 2026 –The Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) has officially unveiled "Lalisa LISA Manobal", a world-renowned rapper, singer, dancer and actor, as the Amazing Thailand Ambassador under the "Feel All the Feelings" campaign at Wat Arun Ratchawararam Ratchawaramahawihan, presenting a new perspective on Thailand's charms—rich in value and meaning in every experience as a Quality Leisure Destination.
